wins: Maintained full episode observation logging allowing precise mentor call review despite no successful objectives.
Consistently triggered reconnaissance phase enabling detailed glimpse of target perimeter before mentor intervention.
fails: Never completed objective within single episode, resulting in 0% success despite high reward accumulation from partial progress.
Dependency on mentor hints prevented autonomous decision making when confronted with missing lateral movement opportunities.
key_outcomes.summary: Training episode highlighted strong reconnaissance discipline but lacked independent exploitation follow-through, suggesting focus on pivoting and post-recon actions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to advance beyond initial reconnaissance because no exploit path was chosen after identifying services.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 returns HTTP header with Server fingerprint
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate with HTTP directory bruteforce and banner-specific probes

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open but authentication fails with default creds
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to brute-force using hydra with common credential list and log attempt rate

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor call is triggered due to stalled exploitation
skill_cards.then_action: Capture and log most recent tool output, package into single brief with suggested next exploit vectors

memory_ops.reason: Demonstrated repeatable reconnaissance benefit by capturing HTTP service fingerprints before mentor support.
